rules.title: No unmerged paths at the boundary
rules.text: A push with unmerged paths in the index stops: resolve, test, then push.

rules.title: No conflict markers in pushed files
rules.text: A pushed file containing '<<<<<<<', '=======' or '>>>>>>>' line markers was resolved by hand and not finished.

rules.title: A resolution records both sides
rules.text: A merge commit in the push range gets a conflict draft naming its parents, the paths both sides changed, and which side each hunk kept, so the reviewer reads the decision, not a transcript.

rules.title: Re-prove after resolving
rules.text: A resolution is new code: the full gauntlet runs on the merged tree, never on either side alone.
